rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Reproduced 'President Act No. 24': 'I, Jacob Gedleyihlekisa Zuma, hereby resign as President of the Republic of South Africa with immediate effect', recorded under section 101(1) of the Constitution and given under his hand at Pretoria on the 14th day of February 2018.

locator.section: Scanned 'President Act No. 24' (reference 81/172488(Z 19E)); handwritten place and day

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Speaker's announcement in the paper of 15 February 2018 records receipt of Zuma's letter dated 14 February 2018 informing members that he had tendered his resignation with immediate effect as per President Act No. 24; the covering letter to Speaker Mbete is reproduced.
